title: Product Images & Media
description: Learn how to upload, manage, and optimize product images for your Tijraa store.
content:
Product Images & Media

High-quality product images are essential for e-commerce success. This guide covers uploading, organizing, and optimizing product images in Tijraa.

Image Requirements

For best results:

  • Format: JPG, PNG, or WebP
  • Size: Recommended 1200x1200px minimum
  • File Size: Maximum 5MB per image
  • Quality: High quality, well-lit images
  • Aspect Ratio: Square or 4:3 recommended

Uploading Product Images

To upload product images:

  1. Edit a product
  2. Find the Images section
  3. Click Add Image or drag and drop
  4. Select image from your computer
  5. Wait for upload to complete

Featured Image

Set a featured image:

  • First image is typically the featured image
  • Featured image appears in product listings
  • Set featured image by reordering images
  • Choose best image as featured

Product Gallery

Add multiple images:

  • Upload up to 10 images per product
  • Reorder images by dragging
  • Delete unwanted images
  • Show different angles and views

Image Optimization

Optimize images for web:

  • Compress images before uploading
  • Use appropriate dimensions
  • Save in WebP format when possible
  • Use descriptive filenames

Media Library

Use the media library:

  • Upload images once, use multiple times
  • Organize images in folders
  • Search for images
  • Reuse images across products

Image Alt Text

Add alt text for accessibility and SEO:

  • Describe the image clearly
  • Include product name and key features
  • Help with SEO ranking
  • Improve accessibility

Bulk Image Upload

Upload multiple images at once:

  1. Select multiple images
  2. Upload simultaneously
  3. Assign to products
  4. Set featured images

Image Organization

Keep images organized:

  • Use descriptive filenames
  • Group by product type
  • Use folders in media library
  • Delete unused images

Next Steps

After adding images:

  • Complete product setup
  • Organize products
meta_description: Complete guide to uploading and managing product images in Tijraa, including image optimization and media library usage.
